label: def:bar-involution
title: Bar-involution and its $P_{\mathrm{avg}}$ / $P_{\mathrm{skew}}$ projections: the canonical $q \leftrightarrow q^{-1}$, $\sigma \leftrightarrow \sigma^{-1}$ involution on the Hecke algebra, splitting every $H_n(q)$-quantity into a bar-symmetric (even/cosh/cos/$\mathrm{Li}_2^q$-like) part the framework retains and a bar-anti-symmetric (odd/sinh/sin/$\Phi_q$-like) part the framework projects away.
html:
The bar-involution \overline{(\cdot)} \colon H_n(q) \to H_n(q) is the ring anti-involution on the Iwahori–Hecke algebra defined by:

\overline{\sigma_i} \;=\; \sigma_i^{-1}, \qquad \overline{q} \;=\; q^{-1}.

Geometrically, it corresponds to reflecting the braid diagram (swapping positive and negative crossings).
